task_title: CF-093 is filed on the published tree and its probe reproduces the unenforced README Status rows
task_criteria: Filing-only QA task: do NOT evaluate the underlying fix, CF-093 is pending by design. (1) The filing commit is the tip of origin/main and touches exactly .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl (+1 line) and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl (+1 line) -- git show --stat <sha> shows 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-). (2) git show <sha>:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-093") | [.status,.priority,(.probe|length)] | @tsv' prints a line starting 'pending' 'P4' with a non-zero probe length, and the id occurs exactly once in the committed board. (3) Re-running that row's own probe verbatim from the repo root prints exactly three lines of interest: qualified_command_occurrences=0, SELFTEST: PASS, SELFTEST_EXIT=0, and leaves README.md unmodified (git status --porcelain README.md prints nothing). (4) At the same commit bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS with exit 0, and scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK.
